statement: Intake of the Codex remaining-39 wave. Every row was recomputed against current canonical bytes before any owner work was assigned. Nothing here promotes a track, and the canonical completion ledger was NOT regenerated.

codexInput.importMethod: owned-path import only; the branch was not merged wholesale

liveSetRecomputation.note: The exclusion arithmetic is exact: 16 + 67 + 39 = 122. Eighteen of the 39 carry requiredTreatment=production_packet but are NOT in the D corrected-review manifest — they are the lane-E hard-form and source-blocked tracks (CA CR-180 family, ID, NV, SC, VA, WA, WI, DC). Excluding by the D manifest rather than by treatment family is what makes the totals reconcile.

ownerQueues.basis: Each Codex candidate packet was compared field-by-field against the current canonical guidance packet. All thirteen still differ substantively, so none is closed as stale.
acceptanceConditions: Substantive English and Spanish for every corrected field; Spanish that is byte-identical to English is not a Spanish surface.
paymentAllowed=false and sellable=false preserved on every packet.
No checkout is offered and no packet or partner credit is consumed.
Every corrected legal statement carries its authority; a Codex candidate is input, not authority.
Fresh independent review after the correction lands. The implementation author does not approve it.
ownerQueues.promotion: None of these promote on landing. Promotion requires an accepted independent-review closure and a ledger regeneration in a meaningful integration window.

ownerQueues.basis: Both CR-180 patch-spec defects were checked directly against canonical bytes and both are still live. Neither is covered by the rendered-assertion verifier, so nothing already closed by rendered assertions is being reopened.
acceptanceConditions: An over-length value bound into a shorter field fails the render nonzero; no artifact and no invented '— see Attachment A' addendum is accepted.
The truncate_with_addendum branch is removed or made fail-closed, so the engine cannot invent an attachment the family does not emit.
The 15-day prosecutor-notice period is stated in substantive EN and ES participant copy, not only inside internal source statements.

A verifier assertion fails any California petition-family profile that neither ships a service component nor declares the exact participant-facing service instruction; deleting cr-106-proof-of-service/profile.json turns it red.
Actual PDF and contact-sheet review, not a description of one.
Rendered fingerprints preserved unless bytes legitimately change; if they change, refresh the fingerprints and reopen F3.
ownerQueues.promotion: None. Fresh independent review after the correction lands.

ownerQueues.basis: Verified, not assumed. Each of the eight has committed lane-B exact_supported_deferral evidence with paymentAllowed=false and sellable=false, and an unsuperseded F2 technical_approved closure. The ledger is stale because the terminalization generator recognises exact_supported_deferral candidates only from data/rcap-all50/hard-forms/*/*/profile.json, and lane-B packets only when treatment === 'complete_guidance'. A lane-B packet whose treatment is exact_supported_deferral is invisible to both loaders.
ownerQueues.exactFix: Extend scripts/generate-rcap-track-terminalization.mjs so deliveredDeferrals also loads lane-B guidance packets whose treatment is exact_supported_deferral, keyed by trackId, with the packet file as candidateEvidence.
ownerQueues.safetyProof: Nine lane-B exact_supported_deferral packets exist. Eight carry an F2 technical_approved closure and would promote; the ninth, TX:tx_exp_acquittal, does not and would become a candidate pending review rather than terminal. The fix therefore cannot over-promote.
ownerQueues.expectedLedgerEffect: 375/497 -> 383/497 when executed. NOT executed in this window.
ownerQueues.whyNotNow: This is an intake window. The standing rule is that the canonical ledger is regenerated exactly once, in a meaningful integration window, when independently approved treatments are being promoted. These eight are ready for exactly that; they are recorded here rather than promoted here.

ownerQueues.basis: Two Codex candidate participant treatments, imported into the Codex-owned review-candidate path only. Neither is written into a canonical guidance packet and neither confers terminal status.
acceptanceConditions: Exact evidence for every participant-facing claim.
English and Spanish parity, substantively translated.
Payment suppression and zero credit consumption where the route treatment requires it.
The reviewer is not the author.

ownerQueues.owner: Terminal C source/design owner, or the assigned official-form owner
ownerQueues.basis: Every ledger hold is preserved exactly as recorded. Codex saved hash-pinned official source bytes and separated source text from inference; that is research, and research is not adoption.
acceptanceConditions: The exact official-source requirement recorded on the track is met, not approximated.
Secondary authority is never substituted for an operative legal claim.
The supported fallback terminal disposition already recorded for the track is preserved until the source lands.

ownerQueues.basis: A legal-design question. Research does not close it and the hold stays until counsel answers it.

Deduplicated against the current canonical runtime: of Codex's 31 runtime specifications, 30 target tracks with no compiled pathway and 1 (OK:ok_clean_slate) is already represented and drops out. Twenty-nine of the thirty are gated behind a non-runtime primary blocker that must close first.
ownerQueues.captainFinding: ZERO captain-owned shared-runtime changes are applicable today. Every remaining specification asks for a compiled pathway — profile authoring — not a change to a shared payment, credit, Briefcase or route-state system. No competing system is created and none is needed.
acceptanceConditions: The track's primary blocker closes first.
A compiled pathway is authored with its own acceptance tests.
No second payment, credit, Briefcase or route-state system.

reviewRouting.principle: No implementation author approves their own work.

ledger.reason: Intake only. The canonical ledger is regenerated exactly once, in a meaningful integration window, when independently approved treatments are being promoted.
